Hartford Investment Management Co decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 8.54% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hartford Investment Management Co sold 95,365 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1.02M shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $171.28 million, down from 1.12 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hartford Investment Management Co who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $916.67 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.44% or $0.81 during the last trading session, reaching $186.5. About 17.22M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Hartford Investment Management Co, which manages about $5.02 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Ishares Russell Mid (IWS) by 50,610 shares to 139,527 shares, valued at $12.06M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Spdr S&P Etf Trust (SPY) by 180,840 shares in the quarter, for a total of 408,840 shares, and has risen its stake in Ishares Russell Value Et (IWN).
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 EPS, up 31.14 % or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76 billion for 21.29 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality.
